messages:
oliver: Quick idea  rooftop lunch + 20-min trivia rounds on Wed 7/10 at 12:30? Pack-your-own or order from nearby deli. Who's keen?
maya: Love this! I can bring a small bluetooth speaker and a stack of index cards for scorekeeping. :speaker_high_volume: :card_file_box:
harper: In if there's a vegetarian option. Also happy to DJ trivia categories.
jules: Typing "in" as long as it's not the week of the release. 12:30 works.
oliver: Great  if we order, options nearby: Oak & Rye (sandwiches) or Verde Kitchen (bowls). React: :sandwich: = Oak & Rye, :green_salad: = Verde.
maya: :sandwich:
harper: :green_salad: (veg for me)
caterina: Im remote that day but would love to pop in on the Zoom for the last round. Can we have a quick link?
oliver: Yep I'll post a Zoom link and a short sign-up for trivia teams.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Rooftop Lunch + Trivia"  Wed Jul 10  12:30 PM  RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/event/trivia456 (reminder 1 hour prior)
jules: Also can we make rounds short  like 5 questions each, 4 rounds? Keeps energy up.
maya: Works for me. Ill bring pens and a prize (mystery box sticker pack).
harper: I'll coordinate orders  looks like a sandwich/vegetarian split. cya on the roof or Zoom.
caterina: Thanks! I'll try to make the last round via video.
oliver: Perfect  provisional plan: 12:30 on the roof, Oak & Rye + Verde order, Zoom link posted Tues evening. Please RSVP on the calendar link so I can finalize food counts. :thumbsup:
